source.note: Fedya Master v02 (06.10.2026), north up. The PNG is a 1280x714 downscaled screenshot: the right 53 px are a dark viewer margin and the left 6 px a dark edge; top and bottom of the map are cut by the frame. Object-key and base-key texts (2-3 px tall) are not readable even at 3-4x. The subtitle seems to say "1 unit = 0.2 m" (illegible; not used).

transform.uncertainty: about +-0.5 percent (bar edges anti-aliased; fit residual max 0.202 px over 98.81 px)
transform.origin_definition: bottom-left corner of the land bbox (land = frame minus the connected sea; mountains count as land). Source-pixel coordinates are continuous: pixel (i, j) covers [i, i+1) x [j, j+1); its centre is (i+0.5, j+0.5).

extents.land_note: land bbox includes the mountain ridge (world edge) and runs to the frame on the W and N sides; sea south of y=0 has negative y
extents.approx_playable_note: hand estimate, +-10 m: mountain foot ~x60 px on the W, ~y55-195 px on the N; S coast ~y668 px; E to the port pier/outfall ~x1170 px. About 1.12 km E-W x 0.62 km N-S: wider than v14 (971 x 672 m) and over v14's "playable extent <= 1000 m" check -> lead/Fedya decision (scale bar taken as truth).

v14_comparison.note: Master v02 replaces the v14 layout; no v14 coordinates carry over except the marina geometry (transplant MAP_PLAN_R01_v14.json "marina" by a rigid transform onto the elite coast).

badges_note: 5 dark player-base badges confirmed; none found yet in 03, 06, 07, 09 (may be lighter or absent). Texts unreadable.

tracer_rules: Trace in the *_grid.png (or compute from the clean crop with crop_px_to_m); write metres rounded to 0.1 m.
Polygons counter-clockwise, not closed (first point not repeated), >=3 points; polylines in travel order.
Widths come from the road class table, not from the blurry pixels (asphalt 2 lanes max).
Record uncertainty instead of guessing: put doubtful items in the fragment "questions_ru".
